normalization_plan.reason: the target parameter is only the argument written into auth_list by SetAuth and adds no independent security semantics
the acc parameter is fully consumed by OwnerAble and the payout inside Withdraw
the caller supplied random value only feeds chip generation and is meaningless outside that function
the accounts array is only the migration iteration input of SyncOldData
the oldMain reference is only used as an external data source inside SyncOldData
the bonus amount parameter only feeds the pool updates in AddBonus
loop index i exists solely to drive the faulty shifting loop of IndexList.insert
tempBonus is a transient accumulator local to RefreshDayBonus
the weight accumulator is only meaningful during weighted chip selection
local r only carries the weak random value produced by GenRandom
